evidence.quote: But--and this is no small "but"--the global recovery has been disappointing.
Many of those who dropped out of the labor force may be discouraged workers.
there are real risks that cyclical slumps can become structural; it may also be possible to reverse or prevent declines from becoming permanent through expansive macroeconomic policies.
With these and other possible tools, we will be able to raise rates and maintain them near their targeted level at the appropriate time.
I do not think that financial stability concerns warrant deviating from our traditional focus on inflation and employment.
